title: The Proclamation of the Kingdom: Third Luminous Mystery
summary: Pray the Third Luminous Mystery page by page: the story of the Proclamation of the Kingdom, the Gospel, the decade prayers, and a quiet reflection.
coverAlt: Bloch's painting of the Sermon on the Mount: Jesus preaches the kingdom of God.

pages.title: The Proclamation of the Kingdom
pages.body: Jesus walked through Galilee preaching: The kingdom of God is at hand; repent, and believe the gospel. His words called people to change their hearts and come home to God. As we pray this decade, we ask for hearts that listen and turn back to him.
pages.alt: Bloch's painting of the Sermon on the Mount: Jesus preaches the kingdom of God.

pages.title: From the Gospel
pages.body:
God's Word tells us this mystery. From the Gospel according to Mark, chapter 1 (Douay-Rheims Bible):

“And after that John was delivered up, Jesus came into Galilee, preaching the gospel of the kingdom of God, And saying: The time is accomplished, and the kingdom of God is at hand: repent, and believe the gospel.”

(Mark 1:14-15)

pages.title: Praying the Decade
pages.body:
We announce the mystery: The Proclamation of the Kingdom, the Third Luminous Mystery. Then we pray one decade of the Rosary, holding this scene in our hearts.

Our Father, who art in heaven, hallowed be Thy name; Thy kingdom come; Thy will be done on earth as it is in heaven. Give us this day our daily bread; and forgive us our trespasses, as we forgive those who trespass against us; and lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil. Amen.

Hail Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee. Blessed art thou among women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus. Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen. (We pray the Hail Mary ten times, once for each bead of the decade.)

Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit; as it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

O my Jesus, forgive us our sins, save us from the fires of hell; lead all souls to Heaven, especially those in most need of Thy mercy.

pages.title: The Fruit of This Mystery: Conversion and Christian witness
pages.body:
This mystery grows the fruit of conversion and Christian witness. Repent means turn around. Is there one habit you could turn around this week?

Let us pray: Lord Jesus, give us hearts that turn to you quickly and gladly. Amen. Our Lady of the Rosary, pray for us.
